questionGroups.html:
Questions 1–10

Complete the notes below.

Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

Job details from employment agency
Role:
Location: Fordham Centre
Road, Fordham
Work involves
dealing with enquiries making and reorganising them
maintaining the internal
general administration
Requirements
(essential)
a calm and manner
good IT skills
Other information
a job
further opportunities may be available
hours: 7.45 a.m. to p.m. Monday to Friday
is available onsite

transcript.en: Julie: Hello?
transcript.zh: 你好？

transcript.en: Greg: Oh, hello. Is that Julie Davison?
transcript.zh: 你好。是朱莉吗?

transcript.en: Julie: Yes.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: Greg: This is Greg Preston from the Employment Agency. We met last week when you came in to enquire about office work.
transcript.zh: 我是Greg Preston，来自就业机构。上周你来询问办公室工作时我们见过面。

transcript.en: Julie: Oh, that’s right.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: Greg: Now we’ve just had some details come in of a job which might interest you.
transcript.zh: 我们刚收到一份可能你会感兴趣的工作情况。

transcript.en: Julie: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Greg: So this is a position for a receptionist – I believe you’ve done that sort of work before?
transcript.zh: 这是一个接待员的职位——我认为你以前做过这样的工作？

transcript.en: Julie: Yes, I have, I worked in a sports centre for a couple of years before I got married and had the children.
transcript.zh: 是的，我做过，我在结婚生子之前在一个体育中心工作了几年。

transcript.en: Greg: Right. Well, this job’s in Fordham, so not too far away for you, and it’s at the medical centre there.
transcript.zh: 好的。这个工作地点在福德汉姆，对你来说不太远，是在那里的医疗中心。

transcript.en: Julie: OK. So where exactly is that?
transcript.zh: 好的。那具体在哪里？

transcript.en: Greg: It’s quite near the station, on Chastons Road.
transcript.zh: 离车站很近，在查斯顿斯路上。

transcript.en: Julie: Sorry?
transcript.zh: 哪里？

transcript.en: Greg: Chastons Road – that’s C-H-A-S-T-O-N-S.
transcript.zh: 查斯顿斯路——拼写是C-H-A-S-T-O-N-S。

transcript.en: Julie: OK, thanks. So what would the work involve? Dealing with enquiries from patients?
transcript.zh: 好的，谢谢。那这份工作会涉及什么？处理来自病人的咨询吗？

transcript.en: Greg: Yes, and you’d also be involved in making appointments, whether face to face or on the phone. And rescheduling them if necessary.
transcript.zh: 是的，而且你还需要参与预约工作，包括面对面或通过电话。如果需要的话，还需要重新安排预约。

transcript.en: Julie: Fine, that shouldn’t be a problem.
transcript.zh: 好的，这应该没问题。

transcript.en: Greg: And another of your duties would be keeping the centre’s database up-to-date. Then you might have other general administrative duties as well, but those would be the main ones.
transcript.zh: 你的另一个职责是保持中心的数据库更新。然后你可能还会有其他一般行政职责，但那些（更新数据库）将是主要的。

transcript.en: Julie: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Greg: Now when the details came in, I immediately thought of you because one thing they do require is someone with experience, and you did mention your work at the sports centre when you came in to see us.
transcript.zh: 当收到这些信息时，我立即想到了你，因为他们强调需要有经验的人，而你在来见我们的时候提到过你在体育中心的工作。

transcript.en: Julie: Yes, in fact I enjoyed that job. Is there anything else they’re looking for?
transcript.zh: 是的，事实上我很喜欢那份工作。他们还有其他什么要求吗？

transcript.en: Greg: Well, they say it’s quite a high-pressure environment, they’re always very busy, and patients are often under stress, so they want someone who can cope with that and stay calm, and at the same time be confident when interacting with the public.
transcript.zh: 嗯，他们说那是一个压力很大的环境，他们总是很忙，病人常常处于紧张状态，所以他们需要一个能够应对并保持冷静的人，同时在与大家交往时要有自信。

transcript.en: Julie: Well, after dealing with three children all under five, I reckon I can cope with that.
transcript.zh: 嗯，在应对五岁以下的三个孩子之后，我觉得（这个工作）我能应付得了。

transcript.en: Greg: I’m sure you can.
transcript.zh: 我相信你能。

transcript.en: Greg: And then another thing they mention is that they’re looking for someone with good IT skills …
transcript.zh: 然后他们还提到，他们正在寻找具备良好IT技能的人……

transcript.en: Julie: Not a problem.
transcript.zh: 没问题。

transcript.en: Greg: So you’d be interested in following this up?
transcript.zh: 那你愿意继续跟进？

transcript.en: Julie: Sure. When would it start?
transcript.zh: 当然。这份工作什么时候开始？

transcript.en: Greg: Well, they’re looking for someone from the beginning of next month, but I should tell you that this isn’t a permanent job, it’s temporary, so the contract would be just to the end of September. But they do say that there could be further opportunities after that.
transcript.zh: 他们希望找人从下个月初开始工作，但我需要知会你，这不是一个永久工作，只是临时的，合同到九月底。但他们确实说在那之后可能会有进一步的机会。

transcript.en: Julie: OK. And what would the hours be?
transcript.zh: 好的。工作时间是多久？

transcript.en: Greg: Well, they want someone who can start at a quarter to eight in the morning – could you manage that?
transcript.zh: 他们希望有人可以早上七点四十五分开始工作——你能办到吗？

transcript.en: Julie: Yes, my husband would have to get the kids up and off to my mother’s – she’s going to be looking after them while I’m at work. What time would I finish?
transcript.zh: 是的，我丈夫叫醒孩子，把他们送到我妈妈那里，她会在我工作时照顾他们。我什么时候下班？

transcript.en: Greg: One fifteen.
transcript.zh: 下午一点十五分。

transcript.en: Julie: That should work out all right. I can pick the kids up on my way home, and then I’ll have the afternoon with them. Oh, one thing … is there parking available for staff at the centre?
transcript.zh: 那应该没问题。我可以在回家的路上接孩子，然后下午有时间陪他们。哦，还有一件事……中心的员工有停车位吗？

transcript.en: Greg: Yes, there is, and it’s also on a bus route.
transcript.zh: 有的，而且还有公交车线路经过那里。

transcript.en: Julie: Right. Well, I expect I’ll have the car but it’s good to know that. OK, so where do I go from here?
transcript.zh: 好的。我应该是开车去，但知晓有公交车也很好。那好，接下来怎么办？

transcript.en: Greg: Well, if you’re happy for me to do so, I’ll forward your CV and references, and then the best thing would probably be for you to phone them so they can arrange for an interview.
transcript.zh: 如果你同意，我将转发你的简历和推荐信，然后你最好给他们打电话，这样他们可以安排面试。

transcript.en: Julie: Great. Well thank you very much.
transcript.zh: 太好了。非常感谢你。

transcript.en: Greg: You’re welcome. Bye now.
transcript.zh: 不客气。再见。

transcript.en: Julie: Bye.
transcript.zh: 再见。
